name: crewai
description: CrewAI's native A2A server: pass a2a=A2AServerConfig(url="http://127.0.0.1:8000") to the Agent; when crew.kickoff() starts, it publishes the Agent Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json and accepts A2A JSON-RPC tasks (A2AClientConfig is an equally first-class counterpart on the client side).

metadata.install: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install "crewai[a2a]" && crewai create crew my_crew
metadata.start: python server.py  # crew.kickoff() → A2A server on :8000
